checks.detail: High-risk transfer created an FDS hold without posting to the ledger
FDS release posted the transfer only after checker approval
FDS block updated case and transfer result without adding a ledger posting
High-risk customer transfer generated an AML case and closed through approval
Daily closing validated ledger totals and created an owned unmatched item
Closed business day rejected direct mutation and adjustment posted on the next open day
FDS, AML, and reconciliation case screens are manifest-declared
Risk and reconciliation workflows produced approval, execution, and batch audit events
